dct_title_s: Earthquake impact mapping from drones in Sanfebagar, Achham District, Nepal (November 2022)
dct_description_sm: Earthquake impacts mapping from drone data in Nepal (Sanfebagar, Achham District, Sudurpashchim Province) from GLOBHE Crowddroner. The dataset includes high-resolution actionable drone data showing the area impacted from the earthquakes of early November 2022.
